brief.goal: Implement the minimal backend-only single-confirmation OE3 Node 1-7 workflow using existing resource executors.

allowed_writes: workflow, skill, repository, executor scope and CLI source code
one unique database migration for plan-bound confirmation compatibility
task, manifest and project control-plane status
test_run audit records created and cleaned by smoke
forbidden_actions: real OceanEngine or Qiankun platform write
new event, micro-app binding or landing-page share executor
raw payload, raw response, complete URL, token, secret, Cookie, auth_code or complete request ID persistence
validation_plan: validate READY/PLANNED/BLOCKED classification and root blocker selection
validate one immutable plan and one plan-bound confirmation
validate existing resource executors through a shared action grant
validate Node 5 fail-fast orchestration and final draft derivation
validate Node 6 calls create at most once under fake transport
run existing executor and payload/create regression smoke
stop_conditions: Any command would perform a real platform write.
Implementation requires duplicating an existing resource executor or payload builder.
An unsupported event, micro-app or backup landing-page write capability would be required.
Existing user changes overlap in a way that cannot be preserved safely.

solution_link.source: docs/project-最合理的逻辑图.md and approved backend-only single-confirmation plan
solution_link.objective: Implement the smallest durable backend mechanism without frontend or duplicate executors.
solution_link.current_truth: Postgres marketing_workbench_v2.mwb, current code and this manifest.
solution_link.stop_condition: Zero real platform writes during implementation and validation.
